entries.title: Collapse a task's parts and still see its progress
entries.body: In the Tasks panel, a task with parts now shows how many are finished, such as 2/5. Click the count, or press ← on the task, to hide its parts; a thin bar under the task then shows each part finished, working or waiting. A part that waits on you stays shown, and a collapsed task stays collapsed after a restart. Expand all parts and Collapse all parts are in command search.

picture.alt: The Tasks panel with a pinned task reading 2/5 and collapsed, a five-part bar under it with two parts filled, and below it in Backlog an expanded task reading 1/3 with its parts listed
